== Summary ==
Original slip, 24 November 2004: Jabba's Space Cruiser (V), as printed on the Players Committee's release sheet for [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf Virtual Set #8 release sheet] (Players Committee, 24 November 2004; VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 5 December 2004), page 3, slip 39. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court) (Original)|Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Set 8)]].
